name: play-button-mirrors-core-pause
description: The real Quick play control's bound presentation agrees with the VideoSession pause state in both running and paused states.

steps.name: playing
steps.note: The Quick VideoSession starts this direct media load playing, so no initial press is needed.
Back to running, so both states are checked rather than only the one the click produced.

steps.note: Every assertion is evaluated against the FINAL state, so the last thing that happens is the agreement under test rather than an intermediate one.

assertions.note: The actual Quick button's bound tooltip says Pause while the session reports running, so the visible control and core agree.
The core's pause flag is read back from the live VideoSession.
